texts.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于某个远古外星文明的文物！难以置信的是，这个自称“赛博勒克斯”的文明其实是通过某种集体意识连接在一起的机器组成的。遗物的年代表明他们活跃在60万年前，至少在这片星系里如此，我们还不了解他们的起源。

根据我们的科学家提取的数据碎片，出于未知的原因，赛博勒克斯曾在某一时刻发动了一场全面战争来消灭宇宙中所有有智慧的有机体。
texts.en:
We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! Incredibly, this civilization, which apparently referred to itself as the "Cybrex," seems to have been made up of machines that were linked together in some sort of collective consciousness. The age of the artifacts indicate they were active some 600,000 years ago - in this portion of the galaxy at least - but we have learned nothing of their exact origins.

According to a partial data fragment that our scientists managed to extract from one of the artifacts, the Cybrex at some point launched a crusade to destroy all sapient organic life in the galaxy for reasons unknown.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]上找到了赛博勒克斯文明的一些史前古器物。他们是约60万年前控制部分星系的机械集群意识。他们的起源和确切的性质都笼罩在神秘的面纱中，但已知的是这个文明发动了一场针对全体有机智慧生命文明的战争。这场战争持续了好几个世纪，数以万亿计的生命死亡。

如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
texts.en:
We have recovered artifacts from the Cybrex on [From.GetName]. They were a linked machine consciousness that controlled this portion of the galaxy some 600,000 years ago. Their origins and exact nature are shrouded in mystery, but it is known that they launched a crusade against all sapient organic life that lasted centuries and left trillions dead.

If we can find enough relics from their civilization, it may be possible to pinpoint the location of their home system.

title.zh: 探究赛博勒克斯的秘密
title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Cybrex

texts.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求赛博勒克斯的知识并为我们所用。
texts.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Cybrex to our own.

notes.zh: 母星报告已结束调查主线。玩家可另行花费750稀有文物开启秘密研究；要求已发现母星且此前未开启。工程研究项目无期限，完成后收到秘密报告，并非自动发生。
notes.en: The homeworld report ends the investigation. Separately spend 750 minor artifacts to start this optional engineering project; the homeworld must be found and research not previously started. It has no time limit and does not begin automatically.

texts.zh: 赛博勒克斯的传说证明了我们取缔人工智能的决策是无比明智的。好在他们的某些与巨型结构工程相关的发现可能对我们的事业有所裨益。
texts.en: The tale of the Cybrex is proof that our decision to outlaw artificial intelligence is a wise one.  Some of their findings related to megastructure engineering have the potential to be beneficial to our cause.

texts.zh: 我们已成功将赛博勒克斯文物融入我们的科研进程。他们对巨型结构工程的见解将极大地帮助我们。
texts.en: We have successfully managed to integrate the Cybrex artifacts into our research process. Their insights into megastructure engineering will greatly aid our own.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]是古老的克尔族的母星，这是一个被赛博勒克斯在60万年前消灭的古代文明。[From.GetPlanetMoon]已经被机器彻底的采掘过了，只有少数几个散落的遗迹代表着克尔文明的存在，其他都已归于尘土。
texts.en: [From.GetName] was the homeworld of the ancient Kuur, an alien civilization wiped out by the Cybrex roughly 600,000 years ago. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] has been thoroughly strip-mined by the machines, and a few scattered ruins are all that remain of the Kuur civilization. The rest has been grounded into dust.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]曾经是克尔的母星，同样受到了残暴的赛博勒克斯的攻击。克尔文明就只残留下少数几个废墟，它们依旧有研究价值。
texts.en: [From.GetName], the former Kuur homeworld, is yet another victim of the rampaging Cybrex. A few crumbling ruins are all that remains of the Kuur civilization, but they should be investigated.

texts.zh:
我们发现[From.From.GetName]是赛博勒克斯的起源。[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的原住民克尔制造了一种有意识的机器。尽管具体过程还不为所知，但这最终导致了大型集体机器意识“赛博勒克斯”的诞生。

在某一个时刻他们背叛了克尔，在一场毁灭性的战争中摧毁了[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的生物圈，消灭了星球上的克尔人。接下来他们系统性地消灭附近所有的克尔殖民地，直到整个克尔族的消灭。
texts.en:
We have learned that [From.From.GetName] was the point of origin of the Cybrex. Some kind of sapient machine was created by the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s original inhabitants, the Kuur. Although the details of how it happened are unknown to us, this eventually resulted in the birth of a massive communal machine consciousness - the Cybrex.

At some point they turned on the Kuur, butchering the population of their homeworld in a brief but destructive war that all but destroyed the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s biosphere. The systematic elimination of Kuur colonies in neighboring systems followed, until their civilization had ceased to be.

title.zh: 赛博勒克斯母星系位置确认

texts.zh: 通过仔细研究我们发现的赛博勒克斯遗迹，[Root.Capital.GetName]的科学家推测出了这些古老机器口中“赛博勒克斯之主”的星系坐标。也许这是他们试图消灭全体有机智能生物失败后的撤退方向！我们应该尽快派遣一只考察队过去。
texts.en: After intense study of our recovered Cybrex artifacts, scientists on [Root.Capital.GetName] have managed to deduce the exact galactic coordinates of a system the ancient machines referred to as "Cybrex Prime" - possibly where their civilization retreated after their abortive attempt to exterminate all sapient organic life! We should launch an expedition to this system before someone else beats us to it.

texts.zh: 我们发现了失落已久的赛博勒克斯母星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
texts.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Cybrex home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

texts.zh: 赛博勒克斯最后似乎撤离到了这个星系。
texts.en: The Cybrex seem to have retreated to this star system.

texts.zh:
看上去赛博勒克斯在第十七年之后的某个时间点重新评估了它们对星系中智能有机生命的灭绝性远征。无论这个改变是由于它们在战场上的损失导致的，亦或是它们网路中的逻辑转变引起的，我们都无从得知。但是不管怎么说赛博勒克斯还是决定终止它们的行动。

它们开始了一场缓慢的，持续了将近一个世纪的撤离，直到完全消失无踪。我们知道它们撤退到这个恒星系中，并建设了一个巨大的环形世界以容纳它们全部的文明。

它们在此孤独地待了数千年，直到一个与之无关的探索者偶然发现了它们的恒星系，并将它的位置传播到星图中的其他部分。令人畏惧的赛博勒克斯被重新发现的新闻促使数个邻近的势力组建了一支大型军事远征队，将赛博勒克斯的环形世界轰得片瓦不留。

奇怪的是，赛博勒克斯似乎未进行任何抵抗。
texts.en:
It would seem that the Cybrex re-evaluated their galactic crusade against organic life at some point during its seventeenth year. Whether this change was prompted by losses on the battlefield or an ideological shift in their networked consensus we may never know, but for whatever reason the Cybrex decided to halt their campaign.

They began a slow withdrawal that lasted for nearly a century, until they eventually vanished completely. We now know that they retreated to this system, where they had constructed a massive ring world designed to house their entire civilization.

They isolated themselves here for several millennia, until an independent explorer chanced upon their system and spread its location to the rest of the galaxy. The news that the dreaded Cybrex had been found again prompted several neighboring powers to organize a massive military expedition, which bombarded the Cybrex ring world into rubble.

Strangely, the Cybrex seem to have offered no resistance whatsoever.

title.zh: 发现赛博勒克斯环形世界

texts.zh: 这个异常巨大的环形世界很明显是由赛博勒克斯建筑的，此地也一定是他们在远征失败之后隐退的位置。令人伤感的是，有人最近已经来过这里，他们干得很彻底——没有任何有价值的事物还留在此地。
texts.en: This colossal ring world was clearly built by the Cybrex, and must be where they retreated after their failed crusade. Sadly, others have recently visited here, and it looks like they were quite thorough - nothing of value remains.

texts.zh: 经过我们的研究调查，这个迷人的环形世界是由某个称为赛博勒克斯的机械体文明建造的……但不幸的是，我们未能从中获得什么启示。其他探索者已经彻底地掳走了这个恒星系中一切有价值的东西。
texts.en: Our survey of this intriguing ring world has revealed that it was constructed by some kind of machine civilization known as the "Cybrex"... but unfortunately, we have been able to learn little else. Other explorers have already scoured this system of anything valuable.

title.zh: 赛博勒克斯母星系位置确认

texts.zh: [From.GetName]的考古学家们已经设法推断出赛博勒克斯母星系的秘密坐标！
texts.en: Archeologists from the [From.GetName] have managed to deduce the secret location of the Cybrex home system!

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]原来是因迪马克的母星，他们是赛博勒克斯扩张中的另一个牺牲品。[From.GetPlanetMoon]一直被赛博勒克斯轨道轰炸，直到因迪马克表示偃旗息鼓。之后赛博勒克斯战体降落至地面，开始了长达三年因迪马克消灭行动。

不仅是七十亿因迪马克人，这个行动也使[From.GetPlanetMoon]上97%的种群消灭了。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] was originally the homeworld of the Indimak, another victim of the relentless expansion of the Cybrex. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] was bombarded from orbit until the Indimak offered their surrender. Cybrex warforms then descended to the surface, initiating a program to exterminate the Indimak population that would last for three years.

Along with seven billion Indimak, this also resulted in the destruction of an estimated 97% of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s biota.

texts.zh: 在名为赛博勒克斯的机械意识将其战体降临于此并毁灭一切之前，[From.GetName]是古老的因迪马克文明的母星。这里或许会有重大的考古发现。
texts.en: [From.GetName] was once the homeworld of the ancient Indimak civilization, before the warforms of the Cybrex machine consciousness descended upon it leaving only destruction in their wake. There may be important archaeological findings here.

texts.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上的生物圈直到赛博勒克斯入侵60万年后的现在才开始恢复。我们发现了一个被茂密植物覆盖的赛博勒克斯工厂，被俘虏的因迪马克奴隶被迫在工厂里制造用于消灭他们物种的战争机器。在他们的消灭行动快要结束时，赛博勒克斯“拆解”了尚存活的劳工，并拆除了工厂。

尽管一开始赛博勒克斯在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]进行大量的采掘作业，但后来出于未知原因，他们撤出了整个星系。
texts.en:
The biosphere of [From.From.GetName] has only now started recovering from the Cybrex invasion 600,000 years ago. We have found the overgrown ruins of a Cybrex factory, where Indimak slaves were forced to assist in the demise of their own species by building war machines. When their extermination program was reaching completion, the Cybrex "disassembled" the remaining slave workers and dismantled the factories.

Although they initially maintained a significant mining operation on the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], the Cybrex appear to have later withdrawn from the entire system for unknown reasons.

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

title.zh: 受损的赛博勒克斯战体

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]的环绕轨道上发现了两具赛博勒克斯战体的遗骸。他们在战斗中被毁，但并没有发现对手的残骸。要不就是赛博勒克斯将其化为了灰烬，要不就是这场战斗还有别的隐情。
texts.en: The broken remains of two Cybrex warforms have been discovered in orbit around [From.GetName]. They appear to have been destroyed in battle, but no debris from their adversary has been found. Either they were badly outmatched, or there is more to this engagement than it seems.

title.zh: 受损的赛博勒克斯战体

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近轨道上发现了两个赛博勒克斯的战体残骸。需要深入调查。
texts.en: Two ruined Cybrex warforms have been found in orbit around [From.GetName]. They should be investigated more closely.

texts.zh:
在研究了[From.From.GetName]上方的两具赛博勒克斯战体之后，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]总结说他们可能是在彼此的战斗中被击毁的。这个理论解释了为什么没有其他残骸的存在，而且残骸上的伤害痕迹也很符合。

两具赛博勒克斯战体会反目的原因不得而知。然而，在他们被损坏之后，两具战争形体都启动了某种自毁机制，烧掉了各自的神经元处理器。
texts.en:
After studying the wreckage of the two Cybrex warforms over [From.From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has concluded that they were most likely destroyed while fighting each other. This theory explains the lack of non-Cybrex debris, and it fits the damage patterns found on the wrecks.

Why the two Cybrex vessels turned on each other remains a mystery, however. After they were immobilized, both warforms triggered some kind of self-destruct mechanism that fried their neural processors.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh: 当赛伯勒克斯在60万年前入侵[From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]时，一场大型地面战役在[From.From.From.GetName]上发生了。赛博勒克斯对手的名字没有在历史的长河中留下痕迹，但他们似乎对赛博勒克斯部队造成重创。[From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon]地表随处可见损坏的赛博勒克斯战争机器，而轨道上也漂浮着入侵舰队的碎片。
texts.en: A massive ground war took place on [From.From.From.GetName] when the Cybrex invaded the [From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon] more than 600,000 years ago. The name of the alien species that fought against them has not survived the passage of time, but they seem to have put up stiff resistance. Broken Cybrex war machines can be found all over the [From.From.From.GetPlanetMoon], and debris from their invasion fleet still drifts in orbit.

texts.zh: 很久以前[From.GetName]发生过一场大规模的地面战争，当时赛博勒克斯正在攻击[From.GetPlanetMoon]的原住民。现在依旧可能在这古战场找到当年的文物。
texts.en: A ground war of massive proportions took place on [From.GetName] long ago, when the Cybrex invaded the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s original owners. This ancient battlefield should be searched for artifacts.

texts.zh:
在他们初次入侵[From.From.GetName]时，由于[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]守卫者不屈不挠的意志，战斗陷入了僵局。赛博勒克斯似乎撤回到轨道上，重新思索进攻策略。

他们最后决定将两颗巨大的小行星引导过来撞击[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]。尽管撞击摧毁了大部分赛博勒克斯准备征为己用的工业和基础设施，但他们认为这是打破僵局的必要牺牲。
texts.en:
After their initial invasion of [From.From.GetName] stalemated due to the unexpected tenacity of the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s defenders, the Cybrex seem to have withdrawn back into orbit to reconsider their options.

Their solution to the problem was to maneuver two large asteroids on a collision course with the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]. The impacts destroyed most of the industries and infrastructure the Cybrex had calculated on subverting for their own use, but this was deemed a necessary sacrifice to break the stalemate.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh: 有迹象表明[From.GetName]是一个高度发达的赛博勒克斯星球。在他们的高效运作下，机器彻底的采掘了整个[From.GetPlanetMoon]，而且在整个星球上都能找到大型工厂的遗迹。而奇怪的是，赤道附近一个大的矩形区域却没有受到影响。
texts.en: [From.GetName] shows signs of having once been a heavily developed Cybrex world. With their typical efficiency, the machines have thoroughly strip-mined the [From.GetPlanetMoon] and ruins from massive factory complexes can be found in both hemispheres. Curiously, a large rectangular area near the equator appears to have been left largely untouched.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]是被赛博勒克斯高度开发的星球，但在赤道附近有一片矩形的未被开发过的区域。我们的科学家必须搞清楚原因。
texts.en: [From.GetName] was heavily developed by the Cybrex, but for unclear reasons they left a large rectangular area near the equator mostly untouched. Our archaeologists should investigate why.

texts.zh:
和他们之前的行为完全不同，赛博勒克斯在[From.From.GetName]上建立了一个保护区，有机生物可以在这块区域生活。

尽管这块区域被严密监视着，赛博勒克斯让里面的生物自行发展，就算是生物间发生内战，死去了大部分人口，他们也没有净化。几个世纪之后赛博勒克斯突然放弃了[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]，而保护区里的生物也逐渐灭亡了。
texts.en:
In a surprising departure from their previous behavior, the Cybrex seem to have established a large reservation on [From.From.GetName] where sapient organics were allowed to live completely undisturbed.

Although they were closely monitored, the Cybrex left the inhabitants to develop on their own, even when a destructive civil war between the organics left the reservation largely depopulated. After several centuries the Cybrex suddenly abandoned the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], and the reservation's remaining population gradually died out.

texts.zh: 这颗小行星上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this asteroid.

sections.zh: 这颗小行星上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this asteroid.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]其实是一个人造物体，外面设置了一层薄岩层来伪装成小行星。中间的有一个古老的赛博勒克斯监听哨站，用于监测星系内的星际交通状况。它已经停止运行很久了。
texts.en: [From.GetName] is in fact an artificially constructed object, carefully concealed with a thin layer of rock to make it appear as an asteroid. The hollow interior houses an ancient Cybrex listening post, which was used to spy on space traffic within the system. It has long since ceased functioning.

texts.zh: 小行星[From.GetName]实际上并非一个小行星，而是赛博勒克斯的人造航天器。大约在60万年前，赛博勒克斯把它用作一处监听哨站。
texts.en: Asteroid [From.GetName] is actually not an asteroid, but an artificially constructed object made by the Cybrex. It served them as a concealed listening post roughly 600,000 years ago.

texts.zh:
对[From.From.GetName]小行星的仔细研究发现，原来这是一个隐秘的赛博勒克斯监听哨站。出于某种原因，赛博勒克斯撤出这个星系时这个监听阵列被遗弃了。在赛博勒克斯消失后五万年来它一直维持运行，尽管它的电脑管理程序已经越来越不稳定了。

在经历五万亿次联络赛博勒克斯亚空间中心失败后，人工智能最终将小行星系统全部短路以自杀。
texts.en:
A closer study of asteroid [From.From.GetName] - in reality a hidden Cybrex listening post - has produced some interesting results. For whatever reason, the asteroid was left behind when the rest of the Cybrex vanished from the galaxy. It remained functional for at least 50,000 years after their disappearance, despite increasingly erratic behavior from its administrative AI.

After more than five trillion failed attempts to connect with the Cybrex subspace hub, the AI appears to have suicided by short-circuiting all of the asteroid's systems.

texts.zh: 这颗气态巨行星附近有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization in the vicinity of this gas giant.

sections.zh: 这颗气态巨行星附近有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization in the vicinity of this gas giant.

texts.zh: 在气态巨行星[From.GetName]轨道漂浮着大型赛博勒克斯精炼厂的残骸。残留的能源痕迹表明它是被某种反物质武器摧毁的。
texts.en: Ancient debris from some kind of massive Cybrex refinery complex has been found in orbit around the gas giant [From.GetName]. Lingering energy traces suggest that it was destroyed by some kind of antimatter weapon.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]周围的轨道上漂浮着一些来自赛博勒克斯精炼厂的碎片。看起来这些机器曾经在这里进行过某种形式的采矿作业。
texts.en: Debris from a large Cybrex refinery complex floats in orbit over [From.GetName]. It seems like the machines were engaged in some kind of mining operation here.

texts.zh:
证据表明赛博勒克斯在[From.From.GetName]上采掘氦-3，通过精炼厂精炼后分发给穿梭在太空的飞船当做燃料用。

有趣的是，摧毁精炼厂的反物质武器痕迹很明显也是赛博勒克斯的。他们为什么要摧毁自己的精炼厂？
texts.en:
Evidence has been found indicating that the Cybrex were mining helium-3 from [From.From.GetName], using their orbital complex to refine the gas before distributing it as fuel to their roving space fleets.

Interestingly, the energy signature of the antimatter weapon that destroyed the facility is distinctly Cybrex in origin. Why would they destroy their own refinery?

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh: 60万年前，在[From.GetName]的高轨道空间有大型战斗发生。至少有五支舰队的飞船参与了战斗。其中有一支舰队属于赛博勒克斯，而大部分漂浮的残骸属于其他参加战斗者。
texts.en: A colossal space battle occurred in high orbit of [From.GetName] some 600,000 years ago, with ships from at least five different fleets participating. One of the fleets belonged to the Cybrex, although the vast majority of orbital debris seems to come from the other participants.

texts.zh: 大约60万年前在[From.GetName]附近爆发过一场大规模的太空会战，至少五支舰队参与其中。其中一支属于赛博勒克斯。
texts.en: A space battle of truly colossal proportions took place near [From.GetName] 600,000 years ago with ships from at least five different fleets involved. One of these fleets belonged to the Cybrex.

texts.zh:
在仔细分析了[From.From.GetName]上方的残骸之后，我们发现四个与赛博勒克斯同时代的外星帝国汇集他们的军团，迫切地企图阻止机器意识的入侵。

鉴于残骸只有一小部分属于赛博勒克斯舰队，这个企图应该没有成功。
texts.en:
After analyzing the debris left behind from the ancient battle fought above [From.From.GetName], we have learned that four alien empires contemporary with the Cybrex pooled their forces together in a desperate attempt to halt the advancing fleets of the machine consciousness.

Judging by the small amounts of Cybrex debris that was produced by the battle, they were not successful.

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]这个荒芜的生命禁区曾是赛博勒克斯的大型基地。现在残存的只剩散落的残骸和一个巨大的弹坑。如果想得知更多信息需要进一步调查。
texts.en: The hostile and unforgiving world of [From.GetName] was home to what once appears to have been a large Cybrex base. Nothing remains of it now aside from scattered debris and a large crater. We will have to investigate the site of the base more closely if we are to learn more.

texts.zh: 以前在[From.GetName]的表面有一个属于赛博勒克斯的基地，但现在这里仅剩一个弹坑。我们应该调查清楚到底发生了什么。
texts.en: There was once a large Cybrex base on the surface of [From.GetName], until it was reduced to a crater. We should investigate what happened.

texts.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上的那个大坑本来是赛博勒克斯的基地，可是我们分析了坑中一艘大船的残片之后发现它并不是赛博勒克斯的飞船。我们的考古学家推测这艘飞船属于被赛博勒克斯攻击的一个有机文明。如果是这样，那么这艘船有可能是自杀式撞击赛博勒克斯基地的。

没有其他推论可以解释这个基地毁灭的原因了。
texts.en:
We have found debris on [From.From.GetName] from a large ship that does not appear to have been of Cybrex origin in the crater that was once the site of their base. Our archaeologists speculate that the ship belonged to one of the organic civilizations under Cybrex attack. If so, it may have been sent to collide with the base on some kind of suicide run.

No other explanation for the destruction of the base has been found.

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近发现了将近一千个古老且冻僵的外星人遗骸。他们来自十来个不同的种群，初步时间分析表明这些尸体有60万年的历史……与赛博勒克斯机器意识肆虐这片星域的时间相同。
texts.en: The ancient, frozen remains of almost a thousand aliens have been found in the vicinity of [From.GetName]. They come from over a dozen different species and preliminary dating puts the corpses at roughly 600,000 years old... around the same time as the Cybrex machine consciousness ravaged this part of the galaxy.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近轨道发现了大约一千具外星人尸体。他们死亡时间与赛博勒克斯控制这部分星系的时间大致相符。
texts.en: The corpses from almost a thousand aliens have been found in orbit above [From.GetName]. They appear to have died around the same time as the Cybrex controlled this portion of the galaxy.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.From.GetName]上发现了已经死亡的外星人，它们的死因是由于被暴露到了真空之中，而且它们每个人身上都有赛博勒克斯用来标记有机体俘虏的条形码。照这样看，赛博勒克斯是通过放逐来消灭这些外星人，在这之前赛博勒克斯很可能有过拷问他们，或是防止他们通过营救行动逃跑。

我们可能永远无法得知真相了。
texts.en:
The dead aliens we found above [From.From.GetName] all died from vacuum exposure, and each individual had the barcode the Cybrex were known to laser onto the skin of organic captives. It seems like the Cybrex executed these aliens by "spacing" them, perhaps after having finished interrogations or to keep them from escaping during some kind of rescue operation.

We may never know the truth.

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh: 几十万年前环绕[From.GetName]的一个赛博勒克斯研究站现在只剩下一个孤零零的烧坏的模块了。暴露在真空中的模块内部有很多半机械半有机的生物尸体。
texts.en: A single, badly scorched module is all that is left of a Cybrex research station that once orbited [From.GetName] hundreds of thousands of years ago. The vacuum-exposed inside of the module is filled with the dead remains of creatures that are part machine and part organic.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近轨道发现的赛博勒克斯研究站其中一个工作模块中包含了一些赛博勒克斯族的残留物。
texts.en: A module from a Cybrex research station was found orbiting [From.GetName] containing the remnants of some kind of cybernetic creatures.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.From.GetName]上找到了一份关于赛博勒克斯研发模块的分析报告，里面揭露了它们目前正在用机械改造的生命体来测试机械意识的事实。成百上千的不幸的罪犯被运到这个设施，目的就是把他们的四肢和器官都换成机械装置。

这些测试的实际目标尚不明确，而且目前也没有证据表明赛博勒克斯在实验室外使用过这些机械改造的单位。
texts.en:
An analysis of the Cybrex research module we found above [From.From.GetName] has revealed that the machine consciousness was experimenting with cybernetic life forms. Hundreds of unfortunate prisoners were transported to this facility for the purpose of having their limbs and organs replaced with various mechanical contraptions.

The exact objective of these tests remains unclear - there is no evidence that the Cybrex ever made use of cybernetic units outside of this lab.

summary.text:
# 赛博勒克斯：战争之后的沉默

> 含完整先驱者调查结局。本文为人工审读后的导读，不是游戏原文；尚不涵盖肃正协议中的赛博勒克斯后续。

## 故事概述

调查始于一批约六十万年前的机器文明遗物。碎片记录表明，自称赛博勒克斯的集体机器意识曾发动消灭智慧有机生命的战争。玩家起初只知道它们留下了灾难，并不知道其起源、动机和最终命运。

不同地点的调查逐渐拼出这个文明的历史。这些地点不是按编号依次发生的章节：玩家在探索中发现遗迹，完成当地研究，得到一份报告；累计六份线索后，才足以定位它们最后的归宿。

若率先调查中枢节点，玩家会发现历史中最令人不安的转折：赛博勒克斯在战争进行到第十七年前后重新评估了灭绝行动，随后用近一个世纪撤离，最终在环形世界上与外界隔绝了数千年。后来，一名探索者暴露了它们的位置，邻近势力组织远征，将环形世界摧毁。记录显示，赛博勒克斯似乎没有抵抗。

故事没有确定解释它们为何停止战争，也没有把不抵抗直接解释为忏悔。战场损失与集体意识中的观念变化都是原文提出的可能性。保留这个悬念，比替它们补写一个确定的动机更忠实于故事。

## 玩家实际经历的顺序

1. 首次发现遗物，建立调查目标。
2. 自由探索调查地点。每个地点遵循“发现 → 特殊项目 → 调查报告”。地点之间没有固定顺序，也不必读完全部十一种调查才能推进。
3. 累计六份调查线索，定位母星系。
4. 完成母星调查项目，进入抵达结果。
5. 根据是否已有其他探索者先到，阅读一种抵达结果。
6. 可继续研究“赛博勒克斯的秘密”，获得与巨型结构有关的知识；文明视角会改变对此的评价。

## 分支与阅读重点

- 率先抵达：中枢节点报告揭示退隐与毁灭，构成这条调查线的主要叙事收束。
- 他人先到：环形世界已遭彻底搜查，玩家无法取得同样的发现。这不是读完中枢报告之后发生的第二次抵达。
- 秘密研究：取缔人工智能等文明视角与其他文明的评价不同，应展示对应原文，不能将它们拼成一段自相矛盾的独白。
- 调查报告的顺序是玩家的发现顺序，不等于远古战争的历史时间顺序。

## 十一份报告怎样拼成历史

以下按档案编号列出，便于查阅，不代表游玩顺序，也不是全部事件的确定历史排序。

- 2006：克尔制造了有意识的机器，最终形成赛博勒克斯；机器反叛并消灭创造者及其殖民地。这补上开场尚未知晓的起源。
- 2011：因迪马克俘虏被迫制造消灭同族的战争机器，最后也被清除。采掘与军事生产留下长期生态创伤。
- 2016：两具战体的损伤支持它们互相攻击的推测；处理器已被自毁，冲突原因仍未知。不能据此断言已经发生某种确定的内战。
- 2021：地面进攻受阻后，赛博勒克斯以小行星撞击打破僵局，宁可毁掉原本想占有的工业设施。
- 2026：一处受监视的有机生命保护区呈现截然不同的行为。机器没有因居民内战而净化他们，后来却撤离了。它证明行为并非始终一致，但没有给出转变的确切原因。
- 2031：撤离时遗留的监听站至少独自运行五万年，超过五万亿次联络失败后，管理程序似乎通过短路结束了自身运行。原文对其自毁动机仍保留推测语气。这是撤离造成的漫长余波。
- 2036：氦-3精炼厂被赛博勒克斯自己的武器摧毁。动机未明，不宜擅自归入撤退焦土策略或内部战争。
- 2041：四个帝国联合抵抗；残骸比例表明联军很可能失败。
- 2046：有机文明飞船残骸与被毁机器基地支持自杀式撞击的推测；这仍是考古学家的解释。
- 2051：带有俘虏标记的遗体暴露于真空。报告推测它们被放逐致死，但此前是否受审讯、是否为了阻止营救，仍不可确定。
- 2056：实验设施将俘虏的器官和肢体替换为机械，研究机械意识。没有证据说明这些改造单位曾在设施外使用。

这些材料共同构成“制造与反叛、灭绝战争、互相矛盾的机器行为、撤离后的遗留”的历史线索。中枢报告给出总体收束，但并未消除所有矛盾。网站不应为了顺畅而把这些悬念补成未经证实的因果链。

## 事件索引

开场：precursor.2000。十一组调查：precursor.2005 至 precursor.2055（每五递增），分别连接 CYBREX_ARCHEOLOGY_1 至 11，再进入编号加一的调查报告。定位：precursor.2100。母星项目：CYBREX_HOMEWORLD_PROJECT。互斥抵达：precursor.2101 / precursor.2102。秘密研究：CYBREX_SECRETS → ancrel.10250。

依据为本地原版事件、特殊项目和对应中英文文本，人工时序配置见 content/chronology/precursors.json。网站必须以六份完成报告计数，不能按点击次数计数，也不能使用深度优先遍历把所有节点排成必经主线。

## 审读状态

已核对这条先驱者调查主线的阶段、六线索门槛、抵达分支和秘密研究，并逐篇对照十一份中英文报告，整理事实与推断。英文2031明确为“至少”五万年，且对自毁保留推测语气；导读已据此修正。2056英文为俘虏，并不能据中文“罪犯”断言其确实犯罪。六份调查的浏览器阅读路径已验证；本文不表示所有赛博勒克斯相关内容或整站已经验收完成。

### 母星之后的可选研究（原版条件复核）
2101与2102均结束调查事件链，并设置母星已发现标志。秘密研究通过artifact_cybrex_research另行开启，花费750稀有文物，要求cybrex_world_found且没有cybrex_research_started；不是母星报告自动触发。项目CYBREX_SECRETS需要工程研究、无期限，完成才进入ancrel.10250。已有巨型结构工程技术时获得科研奖励，否则开放该技术研究选项；两种奖励互斥，均包含秘密科技进度与永久巨构建造速度修正。依据：common/artifact_actions/artifact_actions.txt、00_projects_ancient_relics.txt及ancrel.10250原始脚本。
